rules.text: VAT invoices are uploaded with the Feeds API feed type UPLOAD_VAT_INVOICE (restricted Tax Invoicing role). Metadata: invoice number, document type, total, total VAT, and shipping or order ID. Amazon rejects the upload if totals do not match. One invoice per 3 seconds.

source.title: Amazon SP-API, create and upload invoices

rules.text: Customers can request a correction only of billing name and address. Amazon then lists a credit-note transaction (CorrectionReversal) and a new shipment transaction (Correction). The seller uploads a credit note and a new invoice carrying those transaction IDs. Corrections do not count toward the Invoice Defect Rate.

source.title: Amazon SP-API, invoice compliance and correction

rules.text: Seller invoice upload needs the VAT Calculation Service option "I will upload my own invoices". Otherwise Amazon answers error 79509 (closed beta). Upload stores: ES, UK, FR, NL, DE, IT, CH, PL.
